data.name: Extermination
data.detailed_description:
Prepare to embark on an extraordinary journey across the stars! Dive into the uncharted cosmos, exploring distant and mysterious planets teeming with unknown lifeforms. As an intrepid pioneer, your mission is to pave the way for future colonists by overcoming the myriad challenges that lie in your path.

Your first task: clear the area of hostile native inhabitants who threaten the safety of future settlers. Engage in intense combat scenarios, leveraging your strategic prowess and quick reflexes to subdue these dangers. But your journey doesn't stop there.

Gather and collect valuable components left over as you exterminate the natives. These components are crucial for upgrading and enhancing your robot, as well as building defensive turrets, improving your chances of survival. Your robot's improvements will be pivotal in facing the escalating challenges ahead.

Delve into advanced research to unlock new abilities, technologies, and open new planets. This research will not only enhance your capabilities but also revolutionize your approach to the various threats and obstacles you encounter. With each discovery, you’ll inch closer to becoming an unstoppable force in the galaxy.  The combination of combat and technological advancement creates a dynamic and immersive experience, ensuring that no two journeys are ever the same.

Are you ready to make your mark on the galaxy, to be remembered as the trailblazer who opened new frontiers? The stars are calling, and the adventure of a lifetime awaits!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core, 2.5Ghz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
